title: Some users may be missing the "Meeting options" button for Microsoft Teams meetings in multiple Microsoft 365 apps
impact: Users may be missing the "Meeting options" button for Microsoft Teams meetings in multiple Microsoft 365 apps.

updates.content:
Title: Users are missing the "Meeting options" button for meetings created using the Microsoft Teams web or desktop client

User impact: Users are missing the "Meeting options" button for meetings created using the Microsoft Teams web or desktop client.

More info: The issue only occurs in standard Teams meetings and live events, webinars, or town halls are not affected.

Users are able to access the "Meeting options" button when creating meetings using Outlook on the web or the Outlook desktop client.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Teams and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users are missing the "Meeting options" button for meetings created using the Microsoft Teams web or desktop client

User impact: Users are missing the "Meeting options" button for meetings created using the Microsoft Teams web or desktop client.

More info: The issue only occurs in standard Teams meetings and live events, webinars, or town halls are not affected.

Users are able to access the "Meeting options" button when creating meetings using Outlook on the web or the Outlook desktop client.

Current status: We're analyzing HTTP Archive format (HAR) traces, recordings of impact, Teams web client logs, and Teams desktop client logs to further our understanding of the current impact scenario and to determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: Your organization is affected by this event, and all users are missing the "Meetings" option button when creating standard meetings using the Microsoft Teams desktop or web client. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 14, 2026, at 5:30 PM UTC
